causal_divergence: Base 9834a7194 emitted 'skinparam __theme NAME' at the directive's source line for every non-empty active theme name; the renderers emulate the effect of the nine Java-bundled themes Rust cannot ship from that marker. bdda66260 moved theme loading to an EvaluatedEvent::Theme that exists only when the source is bundled, so for those nine names Java loads a theme (ThemeUtils finds the jar resource) while Rust now drops every trace of it.
invariant: A theme that Java's loadBundledOrLocalTheme loads from its jar but Rust does not bundle leaves the same parser-only marker the base did, at the same source line, and contributes nothing else to identity. Bundled themes keep the evaluated Theme event unchanged.
planned_change: In try_theme, when the name (no 'from') is in a JAVA_BUNDLED_UNSHIPPED_THEMES table taken from the pinned jar listing, push EvaluatedEvent::ParserOnly(source_line_marker(line, 'skinparam __theme NAME')). Every other path is unchanged: bundled themes, 'from' themes, unknown names (placeholder), inactive or too-deep directives.
